description: Uitstoot van luchtverontreinigende stoffen in Vlaanderen door transport is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Vlaamse Milieumaatschappij. An overview of the emissions from the transport sector in Flanders. This is the sum of the emissions from road traffic, shipping, aviation, rail traffic and mobile machinery in Flanders. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in MSG_HTTP. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
